title: Microsoft Teams: grant recording and transcript access when sharing a recap link
summary: Hold: the licensing and meeting-policy prerequisites omit supported alternatives and required organizer permissions. Microsoft also documents recipients for recap sharing and existing controls over recording and transcript access, so the page overstates what is unknown or ungoverned.

claims.claim: The record was last modified on 26 May 2026.
Microsoft Learn does not yet describe this recap-link sharing option.
claims.quote: Searched: 'sharing recap access'; 'recap link access recording transcript'. Opened intelligent-recap-calls-meetings, tmr-meeting-recording-change, meeting-recording and meeting-transcription-captions. Learn has no dedicated description; Microsoft Support does document Share recap.
claims.fix: Keep the Learn-specific statement, but replace 'so what follows about its behaviour is the roadmap's description' with 'Microsoft Support documents recap sharing with people in your organisation through Share; copying a link still lets people without access request it.' Cite https://support.microsoft.com/office/c2e3a0fe-504f-4b2c-bf85-504938f110ef.

claims.claim: All non-channel meeting invitees except external participants automatically get a personally shared recording link.
claims.quote: All meeting invitees, except for external participants, automatically get a personally shared link.
claims.fix: Append: 'For large meetings with more than 2,000 participants, some participants may not automatically receive permissions to the recording file.' This qualification appears at https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/tmr-meeting-recording-change.

claims.claim: Participants without recording access can ask the recording owner to add them to the shared list.
claims.quote: Participants without access can ask the recording owner to add them to the shared list.

claims.claim: OneDrive and SharePoint file permissions normally govern access to meeting recordings.
claims.quote: Microsoft Purview, OneDrive file storage, and access permissions apply to the meeting recording files the same as with other files.

claims.claim: OneDrive and SharePoint file permissions normally govern access to meeting transcripts.
claims.quote: The captions and transcript file is stored with the video in OneDrive for Business or SharePoint. This inherits the same permissions and policy as the video file, so that whoever has access to the video file has access to the captions and transcript.
claims.fix: Add https://support.microsoft.com/office/3cb9acb6-05b2-4f59-a50d-7df61123aa20 to sources for the general statement about transcript file permissions; the cited recording page expressly supports channel transcript permissions.

claims.claim: Non-channel meeting recordings are stored in the organizer's OneDrive.
claims.quote: For meetings and events, the recording saves to the organizer's OneDrive ... To understand what happens if an organizer doesn't have a OneDrive account, see the Recording storage for organizers without OneDrive accounts section
claims.fix: Replace the storage bullet's opening with 'Recordings and transcripts are stored in OneDrive or SharePoint.' This narrower statement is supported at https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/tmr-meeting-recording-change and avoids omitting the documented alternative recording locations.

claims.claim: Channel meeting recordings and transcripts are stored in the channel's SharePoint site.
claims.quote: Channel meeting recordings and transcripts are saved to a Recordings folder in the channel's SharePoint site.

claims.claim: Meeting transcripts are stored with recordings in OneDrive and SharePoint.
claims.quote: Transcripts are stored together with meeting recordings in OneDrive and SharePoint storage.

claims.claim: Recording owners already have the ability to share their recording files.
claims.quote: Users with full edit rights on the video recording file can change the permissions and share it later with others as needed.

claims.claim: External participants have no recording access unless the organizer shares it with them.
claims.quote: All other external participants have no access, and the Organizer must share it to them.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; Why it matters; Open questions
claims.claim: Microsoft has not stated the sharing option's default state or what happens on arrival.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Teams sharing recap link grant access recording transcript specified people permissions admin policy default guests'. Read roadmap, Recap in Microsoft Teams, intelligent-recap-calls-meetings and storage permissions. None states a rollout default for this option.

claims.where: controls[2]; summary; Why it matters; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: No dedicated tenant or meeting-policy UI or API switch for granting access while sharing a recap link is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Teams recap link sharing access Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy Microsoft Graph Conditional Access restrict copying forwarding'. Read recording, transcription, sensitive-meeting options and recap pages; searched Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy for recap/share/recording/transcript. No dedicated switch found.

claims.claim: Feature-specific licensing is not published, so the licensing model is unknown.
claims.quote: Except for joining Teams meetings anonymously, each user in your organization must have a Teams license before they can use Teams.
claims.fix: Set licensing.model to 'included'. Begin its notes with 'Each user in the organisation needs a Teams license to use Teams, except when joining meetings anonymously. No additional licence specific to recap-link access sharing is published.' Cite https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/user-access; retain the distinction from intelligent recap licensing.

claims.where: Cost and licensing; changes[0]; rationale: cost
claims.claim: No separate license, price or meter specific to this sharing option is published.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Teams recap sharing access license pricing meter Teams Premium Microsoft Copilot'; 'Teams license use Teams meeting recording transcription prerequisites subscription'. Read recap, intelligent recap, Teams licenses and Teams Premium licensing excerpts. No separate sharing-option charge found.

claims.claim: Intelligent recap requires a Microsoft 365 subscription that includes Teams.
claims.quote: You must assign your users a Microsoft 365 subscription that includes Teams or a Microsoft 365 (no Teams) subscription with a separate Teams license.
claims.fix: Replace the prerequisites sentence with 'For intelligent recap, users need a Microsoft 365 subscription that includes Teams or a Microsoft 365 (no Teams) subscription with a separate Teams license, plus a Teams Premium or Microsoft Copilot license.' Source: https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/intelligent-recap-calls-meetings.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: Intelligent recap additionally requires a Teams Premium or Microsoft Copilot license.
claims.quote: You must assign a Teams Premium license or Microsoft Copilot license to your users.

claims.claim: The intelligent recap licensing page does not explicitly state whether its additional license requirement applies to this sharing option.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Teams recap sharing access license pricing meter Teams Premium Microsoft Copilot'. Read intelligent-recap-calls-meetings and Recap in Microsoft Teams, which separates Share recap from Intelligent recap. Neither explicitly assigns the new sharing option an additional license.

claims.where: controls[0].ui; Governance controls table; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Meeting transcription is configured in Teams admin center at Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Transcription.
claims.quote: In the left navigation of the Teams admin center, go to Meetings > Meeting policies. ... Select the policy that you want to edit or create a new one. ... Toggle Transcription On or Off.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -AllowTranscription $true enables transcription in that meeting policy.
claims.quote: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity "Your Policy Name" -AllowTranscription $true

claims.where: controls[1].ui; Governance controls table; Governance guidance
claims.claim: Meeting recording is configured in Teams admin center at Meetings > Meeting policies > policy > Meeting recording.
claims.quote: In the left navigation of the Teams admin center, go to Meetings > Meeting policies. ... Select an existing policy or create a new one. ... Turn the Meeting recording toggle On or Off.

claims.claim: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity <policy name> -AllowCloudRecording $true enables recording in that meeting policy.
claims.quote: Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy -Identity "Your Policy Name" -AllowCloudRecording $true

claims.claim: Transcription is On by default for new meeting policies.
claims.quote: Toggle Transcription On or Off. This setting is On by default for new policies.

claims.claim: Transcription is both a per-organizer and per-user policy setting.
claims.quote: Transcription is both a per-organizer and per-user policy setting.

claims.claim: Recording and transcription being turned on in the user's meeting policy supplies the required policy permissions.
claims.quote: For meetings and events to include transcripts, the organizer must have this setting turned on. The user who starts the recording or transcript must also have this setting turned on.
claims.fix: Replace the prerequisite clause with 'For meeting recording, both the organiser and recording initiator need recording permissions; for meeting transcription, both the organiser and the user who starts the recording or transcript need transcription turned on.' Sources: https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/meeting-recording and https://learn.microsoft.com/microsoftteams/meeting-transcription-captions.

claims.claim: When recording is turned off, users can experience recap without the recording.
claims.quote: If recording is turned off, users experience recap without the recording, speakers, topics, and chapters.

claims.claim: Administrators can choose whether organizers can restrict copying or forwarding transcripts and AI-generated insights in meeting recaps.
claims.quote: As an admin, you can choose whether organizers in your organization can restrict participants from copying or forwarding meeting chat messages, live captions, transcripts, and AI-generated insights in the meeting recaps.

claims.claim: The per-organizer policy allowing copying and forwarding restrictions is On by default.
claims.quote: By default, this per-organizer setting is set On.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Governance guidance; rationale: risk
claims.claim: Microsoft has not documented which people can be specified when sharing a recap link.
claims.quote: Share the link to a recap with anyone in your org ... Open the recap and select Share. Add recipient names, emails, groups, or tags. Then, select Share. The specified people will have recap access when you share.
claims.fix: Replace assertions that no recipients are documented with 'Microsoft Support documents sharing a recap link with people in your organisation by adding recipient names, emails, groups, or tags and selecting Share; it does not explicitly document guests or external recipients for this link-sharing option.' Cite https://support.microsoft.com/office/c2e3a0fe-504f-4b2c-bf85-504938f110ef. In Governance guidance, replace the instruction to tell organisers no recipients are documented with 'Tell organisers that Microsoft Support documents sharing recap links with people in their organisation.'

claims.where: Risk assessment: Data exposure; Open questions
claims.claim: It is not explicitly documented whether this link-sharing option changes the existing requirement to share recording access with external participants.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Teams sharing recap link grant access recording transcript specified people permissions admin policy default guests'. Read recording permissions, intelligent recap and Support Share recap. Outlook summary sharing is documented separately; no change to external recording access is stated.

claims.claim: Learn does not describe a Teams admin policy or Conditional Access control specifically over the recap-link grant itself.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Teams recap link sharing access Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy Microsoft Graph Conditional Access restrict copying forwarding'. Read storage permissions, transcription, recording and sensitive chat; Conditional Access search describes service targeting, not this specific grant operation.

claims.claim: Administrative roles needed to configure a dedicated switch for this option are not documented.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Teams sharing recap access link permissions roles default GCC GCC High remove grant forwarded link'. Read recap, meeting-policy references and sensitive-meeting options. Owners are named in the roadmap; no dedicated administrative setting or configuring role was found.

claims.claim: The copying and forwarding restriction's effect on the new permission-grant operation is not explicitly stated.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Teams recap link sharing access Set-CsTeamsMeetingPolicy Microsoft Graph Conditional Access restrict copying forwarding'. Read manage-chat-sensitive-meetings, transcription and CopyRestriction reference. These describe copying recap content, not granting recording/transcript permissions.

claims.claim: The controls Learn documents decide whether recordings and transcripts exist, not who they are shared with.
claims.quote: | Who has access to the recording and transcript (Teams Premium/Copilot license) | No | No | Yes | Yes |
claims.fix: Replace 'The controls Learn documents decide whether recordings and transcripts exist at all, not who they are shared with' with 'The two existing policies in this briefing's table control whether users can record or transcribe meetings; they do not select recipients when a recap link is shared.' This preserves the verified scope of the table without claiming Learn documents no access controls.

claims.claim: The roadmap does not identify which existing recording-sharing steps the new option replaces.
claims.quote: Recording and transcript owners can now grant recording and transcript access to specified people when copying or sharing recap link, and the specified people can access the recap without having to request access.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not explicitly documented whether forwarding a recap link preserves the new grant's access.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Teams sharing recap access link permissions roles default GCC GCC High remove grant forwarded link'. Read Support Share recap and recording viewing permissions. They describe sharing, copying and requesting access, but not preservation of this grant when forwarding a recap link.

claims.claim: Microsoft has not described this option's specific behavior in GCC or GCC High.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Teams sharing recap access link permissions roles default GCC GCC High remove grant forwarded link'. Read intelligent recap and recording permissions; results include general GCC High file-sharing rules, but no cloud-specific behavior for this new recap-link option.

claims.claim: No source says this option automatically widens access or changes existing behavior without an owner's sharing action.
claims.quote: Searched: 'Teams sharing recap link grant access recording transcript specified people permissions admin policy default guests'. Read roadmap, recording permissions and Support Share recap. Access is described through an owner grant or selecting Share, not an automatic permission expansion.

claims.claim: AllowCloudRecording is a user meeting-policy permission to record meetings, not a setting selecting recap-link recipients.
claims.quote: Determines whether cloud recording is allowed in a user's meetings. Set this to TRUE to allow the user to be able to record meetings. Set this to FALSE to prohibit the user from recording meetings.

claims.claim: AllowTranscription controls whether meeting transcription is allowed, not the recipients selected when sharing a recap link.
claims.quote: Determines whether post-meeting captions and transcriptions are allowed in a user's meetings. Set this to TRUE to allow. Set this to FALSE to prohibit.
